name: 横置铁桶柜
prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. A short oil drum laid horizontally on two tiny directly attached metal feet, repurposed into a cabinet; dull ochre barrel with charcoal hoops, rectangular side hatch closed by an improvised latch, chipped paint by hatch. .85x.65tile footprint, height34px at tile144. Cylinder axis along one grid axis; no platform underneath. Closed unsearched. Outside silhouette must be fully transparent, without a background tint/glow or ground. Localized hand-worn areas, uneven small repairs and stable readable silhouette; not systematically scratched everywhere.
